job.job_description:
Job Description




We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer with strong hands-on experience in GenAI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, Python, and AI application development. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and deploying GenAI solutions for enterprise use cases.




Key Responsibilities



Develop and deploy Generative AI / LLM-based applications.
Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines using enterprise data.
Work with LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector databases.
Develop AI solutions using Python and relevant AI/ML frameworks.
Integrate Azure OpenAI / OpenAI APIs and other GenAI services.
Develop and optimize AI agents and intelligent automation solutions.
Implement data ingestion, preprocessing, chunking, embedding, and retrieval workflows.
Evaluate LLM performance, response quality, accuracy, and latency.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Cloud, Software Engineering, and business teams.
Deploy and monitor GenAI applications in cloud environments.
Follow security, governance, scalability, and responsible AI practices.
